description: This is a Java source file implementing the Hibernate-based Data Access Object (DAO) for managing Cohort entities within the OpenMRS project. It provides methods for CRUD operations, querying cohorts by various criteria, and handling cohort memberships.

classes.name: HibernateCohortDAO
classes.description: Implementation of the CohortDAO interface using Hibernate ORM for database interactions related to Cohort and CohortMembership entities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort entity by its integer ID.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Returns a list of Cohorts that contain a specific patient ID, optionally filtered by date and voided status.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort entity based on its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a CohortMembership entity based on its UUID.

methods.name: deleteCohort
methods.description: Deletes a given Cohort from the database.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Cohorts matching a name fragment, case-insensitive and ordered by name.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves all Cohorts, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort by its exact name, excluding voided ones.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Saves or updates a Cohort entity in the database.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves CohortMemberships for a patient, filtered by date and voided status.

methods.name: saveCohortMembership
methods.description: Saves or updates a CohortMembership entity.
